unicode_deduplication.method: Remove source wrapper, NFKC, drop Unicode Cf, collapse whitespace; no claim of semantic deduplication

dataset.labels: Source-grounded model-generated references and model validation; not human gold labels
dataset.relevance: Per-question pooled chunk support judgment; unknown and invalid labels reported separately

pre_response_revision.reason: Replace four incoherent/cross-topic combinations before any formal responses

metadata.experiment: Frozen-pool RRF/cross-encoder ablation plus a separately reported native production pipeline
limitations: Baseline/rerank use a shared original-query candidate pool and bypass evidence guards.
Production uses native rewrite, rerank, evidence review, conflict and refusal behavior; it is not an isolated reranker ablation.
Single run per question; actual selected evidence is independently model judged.
Model-generated references and independent model judgments; not human accuracy certification.
Evidence fact recall is coverage of frozen reference facts, not exhaustive whole-corpus document recall.
Pooled chunk recall is relative to the frozen candidate/context pool.
Uncertain/unjudged chunks excluded from precision and label coverage reported; empty context is not perfect precision.
Production source hit metrics concern final selected evidence; baseline/rerank concern ranked candidates.
Single run per question, current model temperature preserved; confidence intervals bootstrap questions, not repeated runs.
RAGAS uses default English prompts; factual F1 and answer relevancy are model metrics, not answer accuracy percentages.

judge.language: RAGAS default English prompts over Chinese questions and mixed-language contexts
